rules.statement: Changing a subscription item credits the unused time of the old item as a negative line: minus the old unit amount times the old quantity times remaining time over period length. The credit carries the discount in force on the credited period, a used once coupon included.

provenance.ref: dev fixtures with a subscription coupon (builder report); RECON.md's 'credit not discounted' holds only for a coupon passed to the preview

rules.statement: It charges the remaining time on the new item as a positive line: new unit amount times new quantity times remaining time over period length.
Proration is computed to the second from proration_date to the end of the current period.

Proration lines are rounded to the cent: credits round half away from zero, the classic-mode charge rounds half up, and the flexible-mode charge behaves like rounding of a floating-point 1 - elapsed/period (7.5 and 22.5 down, 1501.5 up).

provenance.ref: builder report, pass 2 (dev fixtures); t-round-half-*, b-round-half

rules.statement: Without an immediate invoice, the preview is the next renewal invoice: prorations plus the next full period at the new price and quantity.
proration_behavior=none together with a proration_date is rejected: 'Cannot specify proration date if no proration is being done'.

provenance.ref: d-behavior-none, d-pct20-none (builder report 2026-09-23); the documented behaviour without a date is not probed

rules.statement: proration_behavior=always_invoice previews an immediate invoice holding only the proration lines.
A quantity change prorates like a price change: credit at the old quantity, charge at the new quantity.
A downgrade gives a negative proration total; a negative invoice total leaves amount_due at 0 and the remainder as customer credit.
A price change sent without a quantity bills quantity 1 on the new item, not the old quantity.
A monthly period runs to the same day of the next calendar month, so the period length in seconds depends on the month.

Interval changes. Flexible mode: monthly to yearly prorates the yearly price over the remaining time and keeps the anchor; yearly to monthly keeps the anchor while the proration date is inside the new monthly period and is rejected past it. Classic mode: an interval change resets the billing cycle to the clock time. Yearly to yearly keeps the period.

provenance.ref: t-month-to-year-*, u-year-to-month-*, u-year-to-year (dev); builder pass 3 (dev fixtures), clone/NOTES.md pass 6; edited 2026-09-23 after the final measurement, statements only

rules.statement: A percent-off coupon reduces the discountable lines by that percent, reported in total_discount_amounts.
In flexible billing mode, the discount is applied inside proration lines (proration_discounts=included) instead of at invoice level.
An amount-off coupon is allocated across discountable lines in proportion to their amounts, with rounding.

Classic mode: proration lines are not discountable; the credit is the prorated discounted amount, round((b - D) f), for percent and amount-off coupons; the charge prorates first and subtracts the prorated discount after.

provenance.ref: fresh2-002/081/124/140, u-classic-off-* (dev); builder pass 3 (dev fixtures), clone/NOTES.md pass 6; edited 2026-09-23 after the final measurement, statements only

rules.statement: A coupon with duration=once applies to the first invoice only, not to the previewed renewal.

Classic and flexible modes differ by the order of prorating and discounting (DSC-02, DSC-04), which can move a line by one cent, by the credit line's discount list for a used once coupon, and by the cycle reset on an interval change in classic mode.

rules.statement: A proration_date outside the allowed window is rejected with an invalid_request_error.
The portal home shows the current plan, its price per interval, the next billing date, an 'Update subscription' link and the default card, whose Delete button is disabled.
The plan list marks the current plan 'Selected', offers 'Select' on the others, shows a subtotal for the selection, and keeps 'Continue' disabled while the selection is the current plan.
The confirmation screen shows only the new recurring amount from the next billing date; prorations are only mentioned in the info tooltip.
Opening the confirmation fires GET update_preview; confirming fires POST on the session's subscription, then reloads customer, subscriptions and payment methods.

After confirming, the home shows the new plan and 'Your next estimated payment', which includes the prorations, with a 'View details' button. The estimated payment details start open when the invoice has a discount and closed otherwise.
'Go back' from the confirmation returns to the plan list.
Without changes, crossing the period end creates and pays a renewal invoice and moves the period forward by one calendar month.
cancel_at_period_end=true keeps the subscription active and sets cancel_at to the period end.
When the period end is crossed with cancel_at_period_end=true, the subscription becomes canceled with ended_at at the period end, and no renewal invoice is created.
Setting cancel_at_period_end back to false before the period end restores a normal renewal.

Cancelling now ends the subscription immediately; with prorate and invoice_now a final invoice credits the unused time. The immediate final invoice is a draft with billing_reason subscription_cycle; cancelling now after cancel_at_period_end keeps the earlier canceled_at.

A failed renewal payment leaves the invoice open and the subscription past_due; retries follow the account's retry schedule. Observed: 3 attempts 5 days after the first failure; the spacing between retries is not pinned.
A trial starts the subscription as trialing with a zero invoice; at trial end the first paid invoice is created.
With cancellation enabled, the portal home shows a 'Cancel subscription' link.
The cancel review screen restates the plan and the end-of-period date, with 'Cancel subscription' and 'Go back'.
After cancelling, the home shows a 'Cancels <Mon D>' badge, 'Your service will end on <date>' and a 'Don't cancel subscription' link; the action fires POST .../cancel.
'Don't cancel subscription' opens a renew screen; 'Renew subscription' fires POST .../reactivate and restores the home.
